metadata.name: Signup onboarding
metadata.description: Run the signup wizard as a child chart, then route on the outcome it finished with. The child runs to depth 2: it dispatches its own myapp:signup calls, advances through its own steps and ends with an outcome the on_done and on_abandon slots route on. That needs a root session started with inherit_invoke_handlers: true (statifier-ex st-pvpz), which is what a host embedding charts opts into; without it a child session holds no handler map at all and parks at its first step.

datamodel.description: The signup this onboarding run is for: the child chart is passed its email and chosen plan.
Where the wizard's outcome lands when the child finishes.
